navigation-menu.companyInfo: When a user hovers over a brand, text will appear. This is example text.
navigation-menu.druckCompInfo: This site supports Druck pressure sensing with Order Status, RMA Status & Calibration documents.
navigation-menu.waygateDescription1: On this site, Waygate customers can check order and RMA status, submit RMAs, and find Film or Film Chemistry certificates.  Distributors and direct customer can place orders, check price, and check availability.
navigation-menu.waygateDescription2: Waygate Technologies is the world’s largest provider of non-destructive testing solutions including radiography, computed tomography, remote visual inspection, ultrasound, and electromagnetic testing products.
navigation-menu.nexusDescription1: On this site, Nexus Controls customers can place orders for over 3,000 replacement products, and check status of their orders.
navigation-menu.nexusDescription2: For more than a century, Nexus Controls has provided world-class industrial automation, controls system, and safety system solutions across a wide variety of industrial applications.  Our deep portfolio of industrial control systems and services supports virtually every stage of your industrial control systems' lifecycles - and the people who run them.
navigation-menu.bentlyDescription1: On this site, Bently Nevada customers can check the status of their product orders and their RMAs.  They can also submit new RMA (returned material authorization) requests.
navigation-menu.bentlyDescription2: Bently Nevada offers a plantwide, holistic suite of machine condition monitoring and protection hardware, software, and services that help you achieve the highest level of asset reliability possible - all of which is backed up by our over 60 years of industry-leading expertise and truly global support.
navigation-menu.druckDescription1: On this site, Druck customers can check the status of their product orders and RMAs.  A new feature will also allow you to find Calibration Certificates for your individual products.
navigation-menu.druckDescription2: Druck’s piezo-resistive pressure sensors and test and calibration instruments provide customers peace of mind with the highest performance, stability, and accuracy in the harshest environments.
navigation-menu.panametricDescription1: On this site, Panametrics customers can check the status of their product orders, can create RMA requests and check RMA status, and can pull calibration data for aluminum oxide sensors.
navigation-menu.panametricDescription2: Panametrics develops solutions for measuring and analyzing moisture, oxygen, liquid, steam, and gas flow with proven technologies that are well-known and widely deployed across many industries.
navigation-menu.ReuterDescription1: On this site, Reuter-Stokes customers can check the status of their individual product orders
navigation-menu.ReuterDescription2: Reuter-Stokes designs and manufactures mission-critical measuring devices for precise radiation measurement, pressurized and boiling water reactor monitoring, UV flame detection, and downhole sensors for directional drilling.
